intro.description: I build full-stack applications and the infrastructure behind them. My current responsibility is the technical setup of the IDM web platform at LANXESS, combining a React and TypeScript frontend with NestJS, PostgreSQL and a Linux-based Podman deployment.

services.subtitle: Full-stack engineering, web infrastructure and delivery workflows
services.infrastructure.title: Web Infrastructure
services.infrastructure.description: Setting up Linux-based application infrastructure with NGINX and Podman. Defining the application and PostgreSQL database together in a shared pod using YAML configuration.
services.fullstack.title: Full-Stack Development
services.fullstack.description: Building React frontends with Vite and TypeScript, backed by NestJS APIs and PostgreSQL. Using TypeORM to connect the application layer with persistent data.
services.delivery.title: Delivery & Collaboration
services.delivery.description: Experience with Jenkins and GitHub Actions for CI/CD, GitHub for source collaboration and Jira for ticket-based work. Using VS Code with coding agents as part of the development workflow.

focus.stack.title: Containerized Application Stack
focus.stack.description: Bringing together React, Vite and TypeScript with a NestJS backend, TypeORM and PostgreSQL. Defining the application and database as a shared Podman pod through YAML configuration.

pricing.title: Ways to work together
pricing.subtitle: Four clearly scoped engagement models for software development.
pricing.vat: All prices are net; statutory VAT is added where applicable.
pricing.project.title: Custom software projects
pricing.project.conditions: The starting price applies to a limited, agreed scope, not a complete custom application. Scope, deliverables and acceptance criteria are agreed before work starts; coordination, setup, documentation and risk are included in the project-specific estimate.
pricing.monthly.title: Monthly development partnership
pricing.monthly.conditions: This is a limited service package, not unlimited development or guaranteed immediate availability. Response times and the treatment of unused hours must be agreed before publication and contract.
pricing.annual.title: Annual development partnership
pricing.annual.discount: 10% less than twelve monthly packages (€1,200 saving).
pricing.annual.conditions: This is a capped annual service package, not unlimited support. Contract duration, renewal, cancellation, response times and unused-hour treatment must be defined before publication and contract.
pricing.mandate.title: Freelance engagement
pricing.mandate.summary: Join a team or project for months.
pricing.mandate.conditions: Based on an 8-hour day, the guide price equals €112.50 per hour. The total depends on agreed billable days; no annual utilization or total volume is guaranteed. For one-client engagements, the actual working arrangement should be reviewed for false self-employment risks; a rate or contract label does not rule them out.
pricing.mandate.request: For an enquiry, include desired duration, utilization, responsibilities and start date.
pricing.market.title: Market context
pricing.market.description: The €100/hour planning basis for project and monthly packages is an internal pricing reference, not a claim about guaranteed market earnings. In September 2026, freelancermap reported a €90 requested hourly median from 2,337 active DACH profiles; requested profile rates are not confirmed billed fees. Diemrate's development barometer, updated October 2026, reports a €710 reference daily median based on 2,970 German market observations, not verified invoices.
